initialization: Continue all trainable layers of the in-house randomly initialized CNN. The historical delivery stays frozen.
hypothesis: New, screened field collections improve labeled field validation faster than the same training steps on label-matched historical images.

selection.primary: Master validation macro-F1 across all 177 labels. Screen checkpoints with single view, then compare the best eligible checkpoint from each arm with the deployed D4 policy.
selection.checkpoint_ties: Master unweighted loss within 1e-6, then earlier epoch
selection.field_slices: Three-label Sheikh tomato capture-date validation with all 177 outputs and, when available, the three potato labels from date-held Mduma validation. Aggregate by mean of slice macro-F1. Observe Banu separately.
selection.stop: Run both arms and compare under the same D4 policy. If the challenger fails the field and broad task guards, retain the incumbent. Test any promoted model only after a freeze. Optional blind research comparison is frozen before a single evaluation and cannot be used to tune.
